description: This file defines the NotesRepository class which acts as an intermediary between the data access object (NotesDao) and the domain models for notes. It provides methods to create, retrieve, update, delete, and synchronize notes, encapsulating business logic related to note management.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: Provides an interface for managing notes, including CRUD operations, synchronization status updates, and remote reconciliation.

methods.name: watchNotes
methods.description: Returns a stream of notes filtered by a query.

methods.name: watchNote
methods.description: Returns a stream of a specific note by its ID.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with default values and returns it.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Updates or creates a note with new title and content.

methods.name: getNotesForPush
methods.description: Retrieves notes that need to be pushed to remote.

methods.name: markNotesSyncing
methods.description: Sets the synchronization status of notes to 'syncing'.

methods.name: markNotesPushedClean
methods.description: Marks notes as successfully synchronized and updates the last sync time.

methods.name: markNotesFailed
methods.description: Marks notes as failed to sync.

methods.name: getLastSyncAtMillis
methods.description: Retrieves the last synchronization timestamp in milliseconds.

methods.name: reconcileRemoteNotes
methods.description: Reconciles remote notes with local database.

methods.name: purgeSyncedTombstones
methods.description: Removes tombstone records for notes that are already synced.
